propositions: _repair_ticket bypasses rebuild_with_restore and calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly, so deleted SNAPSHOT sources are never restored during per-ticket repair
rebuild_with_restore is documented as the single entrypoint for the repair path but only repair_or_plan uses it; _repair_ticket follows a separate code path
rebuild_with_restore lacks a no_commit parameter, so routing _repair_ticket through it would commit once per ticket in batch mode instead of deferring commits
_repair_ticket must route through rebuild_with_restore with forwarded no_commit parameter and surface restored filenames in its disp dict
rebuild_with_restore and _repair_ticket must behave identically and remain idempotent across successive repair passes on the same ticket
